meta.description: SOVEREIGN variant of ai-link — sends the case graph to a LOCAL OpenAI-compatible model (Ollama/vLLM/llama.cpp) instead of Gemini, so NO case data leaves the customer. Activate this workflow and set AI_PROVIDER=local + AI_LOCAL_BASE_URL in the framework .env. The backend posts { entities, edges, local_base_url, local_model } to the webhook 'ai-link-local'. Edit the prompt in 'Build Prompt'. Skeleton — finalise the model/endpoint in the UI when a local model exists.
